<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="320" viewBox="0 0 1200 320" role="img" aria-label="Sakib Sarker, SEO and AI Search Expert" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0b1220">
        <animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#0b1220;#10224a;#0b1220" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1d4ed8">
        <animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#1d4ed8;#7c3aed;#1d4ed8" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </stop>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#38bdf8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#a78bfa"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <style>
      text { font-family: 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }
      .name { font-size: 76px; font-weight: 800; fill: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 1px;
              opacity: 0; animation: rise 1.2s ease-out 0.2s forwards; }
      .role { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; fill: url(#accent);
              opacity: 0; animation: rise 1.2s ease-out 0.7s forwards; }
      .tag  { font-size: 20px; fill: #cbd5e1; letter-spacing: 3px;
              opacity: 0; animation: rise 1.2s ease-out 1.2s forwards; }
      .bar  { transform-origin: left center; transform: scaleX(0);
              animation: grow 1.4s ease-out 1.0s forwards; }
      .orb  { animation: float 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .orb2 { animation: float 8s ease-in-out infinite reverse; }
      @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
      @keyframes grow { to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
      @keyframes float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-18px); } }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <rect width="1200" height="320" rx="18" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <g opacity="0.18">
    <circle class="orb"  cx="1040" cy="90"  r="110" fill="#38bdf8"/>
    <circle class="orb2" cx="900"  cy="260" r="70"  fill="#a78bfa"/>
    <circle class="orb"  cx="120"  cy="280" r="60"  fill="#ffffff"/>
  </g>

  <text class="name" x="70" y="140">Sakib Sarker</text>
  <rect class="bar" x="72" y="165" width="260" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  <text class="role" x="70" y="215">SEO &amp; AI Search (GEO / AEO) Expert</text>
  <text class="tag"  x="70" y="265">RANKED ON GOOGLE  •  CITED BY AI  •  BUILT ON CONTENT</text>
</svg>
